hypotheses.paper: cet espace fibré est topologiquement trivial
hypotheses.note: not printed; the action of ℝ₊* is proper (equivalently B Hausdorff); V second countable (« variété », plan F6); then B is Hausdorff, locally compact, second countable, hence paracompact, and the homogeneous norm gives V ≃ₜ B × ℝ₊* equivariantly over B

findings: DEC-122 FINDING: « cet espace fibré est topologiquement trivial » (l.532–535) is false without properness, in every Benzécri dimension n ≥ 3 (DEC-124): the counterexample V of Cone/Counterexample is homeomorphic to B × ℝ₊* by no homeomorphism (Benzecri.ConeCex.isEmpty_homeomorph_dim, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_def3TrivialAsPrinted_dim; n = 3: Benzecri.ConeCex.isEmpty_homeomorph, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_def3TrivialAsPrinted). Any homeomorphism V ≃ₜ B × ℝ₊* forces B Hausdorff (ConeBase.t2Space_of_homeomorph).

The formalization of record for « topologiquement trivial » is Benzecri.ConeBase.exists_trivialization_of_properSMul; the rest of Déf. 3 in Cone/Basic and Cone/Base; the printed form stays refuted (Benzecri.ConeCex.not_def3TrivialAsPrinted_dim) as the paper finding.

prose.statement: « si V est supposé para-compact, on peut donc construire une section de V au-dessus de B »
prose.status: closed in corrected form (DEC-124; correction DEC-122), finding recorded
prose.finding: DEC-122 FINDING: the inference is false in every Benzécri dimension n ≥ 3 (DEC-124) — the counterexample V (Cone/Counterexample) is Hausdorff, second countable, connected and paracompact, and V → B has no continuous section (Benzecri.ConeCex.not_exists_section_dim, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_p241SectionAsPrinted_dim; n = 3: Benzecri.ConeCex.not_exists_section, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_p241SectionAsPrinted): the cited theorem needs the base normal, which paracompactness of V does not give. Corrected form, the formalization of record: V second countable with a proper ℝ₊*-action (exists_section_of_properSMul); for V second countable, a section exists ⇔ B Hausdorff ⇔ the action is proper (exists_section_iff_properSMul, t2Space_iff_properSMul).
prose.reading: « V para-compact » replaced by V second countable (« variété », plan F6) plus the properness ruled by DEC-122 (carried); the cited general theorem on bundles with contractible fibre is bypassed by a homogeneous norm glued with a partition of unity (plan's route).

kb_proposals: A homogeneous norm N(λm) = λN(m) is a finsum Σ φ_x(p(m))·‖f_x(m)‖ over a partition of unity of the base; the term is continuous on all of V because p⁻¹(tsupport φ_x) ⊆ f_x.source (saturation), and mul_finsum needs no finiteness.
notes: Import: `import BenzecriScaffold.Cone.Section` (unchanged). The p. 241 prose is closed in the same corrected form (DEC-124). Wave 4/§ 3 hooks: exists_trivialization_of_properSMul, sectionOfNorm.
